technical_and_design_decisions: For U1, use RabbitAdmin.getQueueProperties() to check consumer count before deleting queues/topics and handle fanout exchange cleanup based on remaining bindings.
For U2, implement an error channel using Spring Integration's error handling mechanisms to propagate exceptions from modules.
For U3, integrate Spring Security with Spring Boot auto-configuration; use basic authentication or OAuth2 for REST endpoints, and adapt the Admin UI and shell accordingly.
For U5, develop a new HTTP source module using Spring MVC with embedded Tomcat, supporting content-type resolution and full header mapping as per the referenced PR.
For U6, implement server-sent events (SSE) for real-time status updates from the administrator to UI clients, with a fallback polling mechanism on the client side.
For U7, leverage the existing Spring Integration SFTP inbound channel adapter to create the source module, and set up an embedded SFTP server for testing.
For U8, use Spring Data Elasticsearch or the native Elasticsearch REST client to implement the sink module for indexing data.
assumptions: The existing codebase is based on Spring XD (equivalent to Spring Cloud Data Flow) with typical module structures and deployment mechanisms.
The developer has full access to the existing source code, documentation, and build tools.
Testing environments for RabbitMQ, SFTP servers, and ElasticSearch are available or can be mocked/integrated.
All user stories are independent and can be developed sequentially; no critical dependencies among them.
Effort estimates assume a single experienced developer working full-time (8 hours per day) on these tasks.
The specification's references to Spring AMQP, RabbitAdmin, and REST API are accurate and the APIs are stable.

activities.activity_name: Implement Stream Destroy Cleanup for Queues/Topics
activities.activity_description: Add an optional --clean flag to the stream destroy command that deletes associated queues, topics, and fanout exchanges after checking consumer counts via RabbitAdmin. Handle edge cases like remaining data or fanout exchange cleanup.
Create an error channel that captures exceptions thrown in modules and publishes them to a user-accessible channel, enabling users to tap into failures for each stream/module.

activities.activity_name: Implement Security Configuration for REST Endpoints
activities.activity_description: Research Spring Security and Spring Boot OOTB features, design security model for XD (admin, shell, UI), then implement authentication and authorization wrapping all REST endpoints. Includes configuration for credentials and DSL shell adaptation.

activities.activity_name: Document Property Keys for Streams and Jobs
activities.activity_description: Write documentation listing available property keys such as ${xd.stream.name}, ${xd.job.name}, ${xd.container.*} and explain their usage in stream and job definitions.

activities.activity_name: Develop MVC-Aware HTTP Module with Embedded Tomcat
activities.activity_description: Build a new HTTP source module based on Spring MVC and embedded Tomcat, supporting advanced content-type handling, full header mapping, and integration with Spring Security. Replace or augment existing HTTP source.

activities.activity_name: Implement Client-Side Polling and Server-Side Event Propagation
activities.activity_description: Add a common polling strategy on client side to detect status changes during stream/job deployment, and implement server-side event propagation (e.g., SSE) between containers and admin server to notify connected UI clients in real time.

Create an SFTP source module using the Spring Integration SFTP adapter, including configuration for file retrieval, testing infrastructure with embedded SFTP server, and integration with the existing module system.
Develop a native ElasticSearch sink module that indexes data into Elasticsearch using either Spring Data Elasticsearch or the native REST client, including configuration and testing.
